# How many employees does Kojo have?

Kojo Technologies, Inc. has approximately148 total employees worldwide as ofJune 2026, according to Revelio Labs workforce intelligence data.Kojo’s total headcount has grown30.9% from 113 employees in 2023 to 148 in 2026.

Data source: Revelio Labs•Coverage: Global workforce, 2023–2026•Published August 2026

## Is Kojo hiring right now?

Yes, Kojo isactively hiring. Kojo had2 active job postings in 2026, a 66.7% increase from 2025— [see job openings & hiring trends](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/kojo/employees#postings).

## About Kojo’s Workforce

Kojo Technologies, Inc. is an Information Technology Services company headquartered in Covina, California, founded in 2018. It employs **148** people worldwide as of June 2026 and ranks 7th-largest by headcount among its [peers](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/kojo/employees#similar-companies).

Kojo's groups are led by Engineering, which accounts for **51.4%** of the workforce, Finance and Operations at **31.3%**, and Sales and Marketing at **17.3%**; Sales and Marketing is the fastest-growing segment, up **28.1%**. The company’s average salary is **$136,153,** with regional medians of **$163,000** in North America and **$29,000** in Central America and the Caribbean, and the overall figure rising **0.8%** year over year in 2026.

Kojo's workforce is highly concentrated in North America, which holds **82%** of headcount, followed by South America at **11.3%** and Central America and the Caribbean at **5.3%**, with smaller shares in South Asia and Southern Europe. The geographic footprint shows a pronounced North America concentration.

Kojo's hiring activity has increased, with active postings up **66.7%** in 2026 to **2** postings, and postings per month moving from **7** in 2023 to **1** in 2026; overall sentiment remains positive and is trending upward.
